description:
As an API consumer
  I want to observe how the posts endpoint handles boundary and invalid request data
  So that I can distinguish service behavior from the assessment's validation expectation

elements.name: A post with a 10,000-character title is accepted or meaningfully rejected without a server failure

steps.name: a POST payload with a 10000-character title and the other required fields
I send the POST request to the posts endpoint
the request body matches the intended long-title case
the response records how the service handled the payload

elements.name: A post title with documented unusual symbols is accepted or meaningfully rejected

steps.name: the following POST payload with unusual title characters:
I send the POST request to the posts endpoint
the request body matches the intended unusual-character case
the response records how the service handled the payload

elements.name: A post with userId omitted is accepted or meaningfully rejected

steps.name: the following POST payload with userId omitted:
I send the POST request to the posts endpoint
the request body matches the intended missing-userId case
the response records how the service handled the payload

name: JSONPlaceholder POST /posts input boundaries

description:
As a borrower
  I want to calculate a loan EMI from the dashboard
  So that I can understand the monthly and total repayment amounts

elements.name: Dashboard loads with the expected heading and loan controls

steps.name: the loan dashboard is open
the dashboard heading and loan controls are visible

elements.name: A positive-interest loan displays independently calculated figures

steps.name: the loan dashboard is open
I calculate a loan of 2500000 INR at 8.5% for 20 years
the displayed loan figures match the independent calculation

elements.name: A zero-interest loan is calculated correctly

steps.name: the loan dashboard is open
I calculate a loan of 120000 INR at 0% for 1 year
the displayed loan figures match the independent calculation

elements.name: The chart shows positive principal and interest values

steps.name: the loan dashboard is open
I calculate a loan of 2500000 INR at 8.5% for 20 years
the chart is visible and its principal and interest values are positive

elements.name: Missing input feedback clears the previous calculation and chart summary

steps.name: the loan dashboard is open
I calculate a loan of 2500000 INR at 8.5% for 20 years
I clear the loan amount and calculate again
validation feedback is shown and stale results are cleared

name: Loan EMI dashboard

description:
As a borrower
  I want to review the details behind my EMI estimate
  So that I can confirm the submitted loan inputs and repayment totals

elements.name: Report displays the submitted loan inputs and calculated results

steps.name: the loan dashboard is open
I calculate a loan of 2500000 INR at 8.5% for 20 years
I open repayment details
the report shows the submitted loan inputs and independent calculation

elements.name: Report navigation returns to the dashboard

steps.name: the loan dashboard is open
I calculate a loan of 2500000 INR at 8.5% for 20 years
I open repayment details
I return to the calculator from the report
the loan dashboard is visible again

elements.name: Missing report query parameters show an error

steps.name: the report is opened without loan query parameters
the report shows a clear error instead of calculated results

elements.name: Invalid report query parameters show an error

steps.name: the report is opened with invalid loan parameters
the report shows a clear error instead of calculated results

name: Loan repayment report
